ownership: package-owned physical eye controls stored separately from appearance-dials/v2 and facial-artwork-state/v3; Eye Convergence renders in per-Goon Eye Contact while Iris/Pupil and Sclera Fit render in their owning appearance editors
zeroLaw: iris/pupil use exact 1.0 neutral multipliers; Eye Convergence logical zero adds the package-calibrated 4-degree inward neutral; all five sclera-fit controls use zero-centered post-fit offsets
symmetryLaw: all eight controls are linked bilateral scalars; asymmetric/per-eye state is forbidden in v1

runtimeBindings.pivotBindingLaw: resolve the current Recipe eye-bone rest first, then compose linked complete-eye Sclera Fit translation/tilt and logical Eye Convergence plus its package-owned 4-degree neutral offset against that rest
runtimeBindings.inverseBindLaw: translation, tilt, or convergence rebases the matching eye-bone rest and inverse bind before gaze performance; never transform child meshes without the pivot
runtimeBindings.conformalLaw: resize each freshly Recipe-resolved iris/pupil disc radially about its local center, reproject every vertex to the current fitted sclera ellipsoid along opticalAxisLocal, then preserve its authored surface offset

controls.label: Iris Size
controls.description: Makes both irises smaller or larger while keeping them fitted to the sclera.
controls.geometrySemantics: radial-angular resize then reproject every iris vertex to the freshly resolved fitted sclera surface while preserving authored offset

controls.label: Pupil Size
controls.description: Sets both pupil sizes relative to the current iris size. Zero hides the pupil; two doubles the neutral pupil-to-iris ratio.
controls.geometrySemantics: multiply the neutral pupil-to-iris ratio, inherit current Iris Size, then reproject every pupil vertex to the freshly resolved fitted sclera surface while preserving authored offset

controls.label: Eye Convergence (Gaze)
controls.description: Adjusts gaze distance. Negative looks farther away; positive turns both eyes inward toward a nearer focus.
controls.geometrySemantics: rotate the complete left/right eye assemblies around their current Recipe-fitted pivots in opposite parent-space yaw directions before gaze performance

controls.label: Sclera Scale
controls.description: Makes both complete eye assemblies smaller or larger after automatic fitting.
controls.geometrySemantics: multiply the complete bilateral layered-eye assembly by 1 + value and reconform round-front iris/pupil presentation

controls.label: Sclera Tilt
controls.description: Tilts both fitted eyes in mirrored anatomical directions.
controls.geometrySemantics: apply mirrored anatomical tilt to both complete eye assemblies and rebase both eye-bone pivots/inverse binds

controls.label: Sclera Horizontal Position
controls.description: Moves both fitted eyes inward or outward together.
controls.geometrySemantics: translate both complete eye assemblies in mirrored anatomical lateral directions and rebase both eye-bone pivots/inverse binds

controls.label: Sclera Vertical Position
controls.description: Moves both fitted eyes down or up together.
controls.geometrySemantics: translate both complete eye assemblies together on the fitted vertical axis and rebase both eye-bone pivots/inverse binds

controls.label: Sclera Depth
controls.description: Moves both fitted eyes deeper into or farther out of the sockets.
controls.geometrySemantics: translate both complete eye assemblies together on the fitted optical-depth axis and rebase both eye-bone pivots/inverse binds
